title: New county emergency operations center
summary: In September 2026 Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA)'s administrator said the agency hoped its new emergency operations center would be running by October 1. The chair raised holding a future commission meeting there.

timeline.text: The chair raised holding a future commission meeting at the new emergency operations center.
Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA)'s administrator said the agency hopes its new emergency operations center will be running by October 1st.
Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) invited commissioners to a July 24 blessing for the new center.
Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) said a roof leak over the computer room is delaying its new emergency operations center.
The emergency management agency said its move into the new Maui EOC (emergency operations center) was pushed from June to July 15.
